title: angular-django2 reactive-form schematic
description: Generate a typed standalone OnPush Angular Material reactive form from a single isolated JSON definition contract.

name.description: Kebab-case name for the generated form component.

definition.description: Workspace-relative path of the JSON form definition file described by definitions/reactiveFormDefinition.

path.description: Destination directory within the selected application's source root.

project.description: Target application project. Required when more than one application is available.

primitivesPath.description: Directory containing canonical form-field output to compose; absent fields use inline Material controls.

reactiveFormDefinition.title: angular-django2 reactive-form definition contract
reactiveFormDefinition.description: A single, isolated, create-only form definition. It carries no resource-operation semantics: it never describes list, retrieve, update, or delete operations. Use data-service or openapi-setup for resource operations.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this contract; ignored by the schematic.

title.description: Accessible form title rendered as the form label.

endpoint.description: Explicit Django endpoint the form creates against.

submitLabel.description: Submit button label. Defaults to the form title.

fields.description: Ordered, non-empty list of controls with unique names.

name.description: Payload key; it must match the Django REST Framework serializer field name.

label.description: Accessible label rendered for the control.

control.description: Native Material control kind used for the field.

initialValue.description: Initial control value. It must match the control kind: number controls take a number, every other control takes a string.

required.description: Shorthand for a required validator. It may not be combined with a required entry in validators.

validators.description: Explicit validators emitted onto the generated control, in addition to the required shorthand and the implicit email validator of an email control. Each kind may be declared only once.

hint.description: Hint text rendered under the control.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text rendered inside the control.

autocomplete.description: Native autocomplete token rendered on inline controls.

reactiveFormValidator.description: A single validator entry. required and email take no value; minLength and maxLength take a non-negative integer; min and max take a number; pattern takes a regular-expression string. minLength, maxLength, pattern, and email apply to string controls; min and max apply to number controls.

value.description: Validator argument. Required for every kind except required and email.

reactiveFormIntegration.description: Optional integration with a typed artifact that already exists in the application. The schematic never creates the artifact.

artifact.description: Path of the existing TypeScript artifact within the selected application.

symbol.description: Exported injectable class used to submit the payload.

method.description: Create-only method invoked on the exported class.
